evidence_relation.A_genai_knowledge_platforms: Evidence on whether generative AI and AI search reduce use of Wikipedia, Stack Overflow and similar platforms; the effect this paper tests for exam-season syllabus pages.
evidence_relation.B_wikipedia_pageviews: Wikipedia page-view research used as a behavioural signal; informs the outcome measure, its limits (bots, mobile, search-engine changes) and the design.
evidence_relation.C_student_information_seeking: How students look for information and use AI tools for schoolwork; the behavioural channel behind any change in exam-season traffic.
evidence_relation.seed: Named in the paper's own prior-work notes; core comparison for the design.
